message.content:
Based on my search, I found the login portals for PreLicenseTraining.com. Here are the relevant login pages:

## Student Login
- **Main Student Login**: https://prelicensetraining.com/login
  - This is the primary login page for students. You'll need to enter your login name and password. (Tip: Your login name may be your email address unless you specified otherwise.)

## Mentor / Recruiter / Company Login
- **Mentor Login**: https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
  - For mentors, recruiters, and company accounts. If you're a student (not a mentor), there's a link to redirect to the student login page.

## Other Related Portals
- **Infinity Schools Mentor Login**: https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- **PSI Online Mentor Registration**: https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/register
- **PSI Online Forgot Password**: https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword

If you're having trouble logging in, you may need to use the forgot password feature or contact PreLicenseTraining.com support directly.

---

Sources:
1. https://prelicensetraining.com/login
2. https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login

4. https://insurance.prelicensetraining.com/page/test-drive
5. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword
6. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/register
